QUESTION:
What is the recommended dose of Levothyroxine Sodium for pediatric patients?

RESPONSE:
Recommended starting daily dosages for pediatric patients (mcg/kg/day): 0–3 months: 10–15 mcg/kg/day; 3–6 months: 8–10 mcg/kg/day; 6–12 months: 6–8 mcg/kg/day; 1–5 years: 5–6 mcg/kg/day; 6–12 years: 4–5 mcg/kg/day; >12 years but growth/puberty incomplete: 2–3 mcg/kg/day; growth and puberty complete: 1.6 mcg/kg/day. Titrate every ~2 weeks as needed based on serum TSH and/or free‑T4 and clinical response. Special considerations: start lower and increase more slowly in infants at risk for cardiac failure; for patients at risk of hyperactivity start at one‑fourth the full replacement dose and increase weekly by one‑fourth until full dose. If the child cannot swallow tablets, crush and immediately suspend in 5–10 mL water and give right away (do not store).
